text:
nora_pm: HeliosSI asked for a compact compliance pack for their marketplace listing. They want a machine-readable manifest + minimal artifacts: SOC excerpt, pen-test attestation (vendor signed), and a KMS/BYOK statement including whether keys are HSM-backed. Can we do this as one presigned tarball?

ashley_sec: Yes. We can produce a tarball with a CSV manifest (they asked for CSV for ingestion), a short attestation PDF (1p), soc_controls_excerpt.pdf (redacted), kms_byok_statement.txt, and README.md.

heliossi_contact: Timeline is tight - legal needs the bundle by Tue morning. CSV manifest is preferred. Also they asked for a SHA256 hash for the attestation file to verify integrity.

nora_pm: Ok. We'll include SHA256 checksums in manifest.csv and also provide individual presigned object links if needed. Owner + TTL required?

ashley_sec: Owner is ashley_sec, TTL default 72h unless you request longer. Evidence policy bot will remind about tags. Redaction rules: remove hostnames/IPs/employee PII and strip exploit details from pen doc. SOC excerpt should list controls and auditor only.

Evidence_bot: [automated] Evidence policy: external presigns <= 72h by default. All artifacts must include owner metadata and taxonomy tag marketplace-evidence/v4. Escalate to compliance@redwood.com for longer TTL.

heliossi_contact: CSV manifest sample they'd accept: 
```
filename,sha256,owner,ttl_hours,redaction
soc_controls_excerpt.pdf,REPLACE_WITH_HASH,ashley_sec,72,IPs+hostnames+PII removed
pen_attestation_trustassure.pdf,REPLACE_WITH_HASH,ashley_sec,72,scope redacted per policy
kms_byok_statement.txt,REPLACE_WITH_HASH,ashley_sec,72,NA
```

ashley_sec: I'll generate the attestation signed by TrustAssure (one page), compute SHA256s, redact, and assemble bundle. For the KMS statement I'll include explicit language: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric CMKs in AWS KMS for service encryption. Customers may provide BYOK; Redwood does not export customer key material to partners."

nora_pm: Plan: (1) ashley_sec posts attestation + kms text for redaction check, (2) nora_pm assembles bundle and creates CSV manifest with hashes, (3) produce presigned tarball and DM to HeliosSI. Target: 2025-09-15 09:00 PT.

heliossi_contact: Good. Please DM presign and manifest to me when ready. Legal will validate SHA hashes before accepting.

ashley_sec: Quick note: presign command I'll use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/heliossi/heliossi_bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 259200` (72h). I'll tag objects with marketplace-evidence/v4 and owner=ashley_sec.

nora_pm: Thanks. Also include README.md with contact security@redwood.com and instructions to request extended retention.

ashley_sec: Will do. Posting attestation for redaction review in ~45m.

Evidence_bot: [automated] Remember to add manifest.csv to the root of the tarball and include checksums as plaintext in the README for quick verification.

nora_pm: Great, thanks team. I'll follow up once presigns are live.
